cards.verse_text: And they were given authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill by sword, by famine, by plague, and by the beasts of the earth.
cards.snippet: …authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill by sword, by famine, by plague, and by the beasts of the earth.

cards.card_text: But the voice says her plagues will come: death and grief and famine, and she will be consumed by fire.
cards.verse_text: In her heart she says, ‘I sit as queen; I am not a widow and will never see grief.’ Therefore her plagues will come in one day—death and grief and famine—and she will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.”
